messages.subject: Juniper - drafting plan / risk points
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Elena,

First full draft of the LSA is with me. Risk points to watch on Wexbourne's side: (1) they'll push the liability cap up; (2) the £100/tonne goods sub-limit will be unpopular for their electricals; (3) they may want a shorter convenience-termination notice. Elena - can you take first pass on Schedules 2-4 (SOW/charges/SLA)? I'll do the main body.

James
